settings.title: YAHLA
settings.intro: Alerts when a device that you have not approved joins the network. Every change needs your PIN.
settings.statusLine: Listening: __listening__. Packets: __packets__, client events: __events__, unknown: __unknown__, forged: __bad__, from other senders: __foreign__. Devices: __fresh__ new, __approved__ approved, __ignored__ ignored.
settings.warnNoPin: No PIN: anyone who can open this page can make changes. Set a PIN at the bottom of the page.
settings.warnNoSenders: No sender set: logs from any address are accepted.
settings.deviceLine: Calls itself __name__. IP __ip__, network __network__, at __where__, last seen __last__
settings.sendersHelp: IPv4 addresses that may send logs, separated by commas (at most 5). Senders seen lately are listed below.
settings.networksHelp: Silent = devices are listed but never alerted, for example a guest network.

code.wrong: Wrong PIN. __left__ tries left before a 15 minute lock.
code.locked: Too many wrong tries. Locked until __until__.
code.unknown_device: That device is no longer in the list.
code.error: The app refused the call or could not be reached.
code.needUnlock: The page is locked again. Enter your PIN.
code.pinRemoved: PIN removed. Anyone who can open this page can now make changes.

settings.warnSilent: No logs received for 30 minutes or more.
settings.unlockTitle: Enter your PIN to make changes
settings.pinHelp: With a PIN, the page asks for it when opened and stays unlocked for 15 minutes after it was last used. Without a PIN, anyone who can open this page can change it.
settings.removePinConfirm: Remove the PIN? Then anyone who can open this page can approve devices and change settings.
settings.removePinAgain: Press again within 10 seconds to remove the PIN
settings.logHelp: How much YAHLA writes to the Homey timeline. Serious alarms and the daily report always come. Flows always get everything.

log.debug: Debug: also your changes, unknown packets and more

alarm.silence: **YAHLA has received no logs for __minutes__ minutes.** Check the log sender and the network. Devices are not being checked.
alarm.flood: **Possible flood of network events**: __fresh__ new devices and __events__ client events in 10 minutes. Someone may be faking events.
alarm.floodCap: **Too many device alerts**: more than __capped__ in 10 minutes. Further alerts are only counted. Someone may be faking events.
alarm.unknown: **YAHLA received a log in an unknown format.** It was ignored. If this repeats, check the log sender.
alarm.forged: **YAHLA received a forged or unreadable client event** (repeated identity or no MAC). A device may be trying to hide.
alarm.tamper: **YAHLA setting changed from outside** (__key__). The change was undone. Check who has access to your Homey.
alarm.socket: **YAHLA cannot listen for logs** (__code__). No devices are being checked.
alarm.storeProblem: **YAHLA could not read its saved __what__** (__problem__). It started with defaults.
